$comment: FR-020 vault-eligibility candidates — feature 024 multi-protocol vaults, constitution v3.0.0.
Every candidate a SparkPoint Fee Wrapper may bind to, with the EXPECTATIONS the CI gate asserts
against live chain state. Checked by contracts/script/vault-eligibility-check.sh, wired as the
vault-eligibility workflow. Read-only: the gate only ever runs `cast call` / `cast code`.
WHY A COMMITTED FILE AND NOT THE DATABASE. Migration 0026 (vault_registry / vault_allowlist /
vault_apy_snapshots) is written but NOT applied, and a CI gate must not depend on a database at
all — the same reason policy-parity compares against committed TS/Python constants. When 0026 is
applied these rows are what seeds `vault_allowlist`, column-for-column: provenance_verified,
PROVENANCE OF THESE VALUES. Every field was read from chain with `cast call` on 2026-07-30 (the
figures in specs/024-multi-protocol-vaults/research.md, re-verified). TVL moves — it is recorded
as evidence, never asserted. What IS asserted is the set of properties that must not change:
factory provenance, the three critical gate abdications, the asset, and a native-fee ceiling.
ROBINHOOD TESTNET 46630 IS ABSENT ON PURPOSE. It has no Morpho deployment of any kind, so it has
no candidates and must never be given a mock substitute (v3.0.0, D3).
BASE SEPOLIA 84532 HAS NO CANDIDATES. Morpho Blue and the VaultV2Factory are live there, but no
third-party Vault V2 exists to wrap — Phase 3 creates OUR OWN V2 over a live Blue market instead.
The gate green-by-skips a chain with no candidates.

gateSelectors.$comment: Recomputed with `cast sig`, not copied from docs. The three CRITICAL setters are the ones abdicateNonCriticalGates:true renounces; a fourth exists (setSendAssetsGate 0x871c979c) which gates the DEPOSIT side and is deliberately NOT required, since N2 only protects the exit.
